full_judgment:
11. Defendant No.4 contested the suit filing a separate written statement stating, inter alia, that 2.11 acres of land of C.S. Plot No.564 corresponding to R.S. plot Nos. 977-979 is the land of Khas Khatian No.1 which has been recorded in the name of government during R.S. operation. The character of the land was shown as khal. Upon application a project was taken after forming a project committee and defendant No.4 was appointed as the president of the said committee. The project committee re-excavated the canal (Khal) in exchange for the wheat provided by the Government and cultivating fish in the said re-excavated Khal. 

 23. It is admitted that suit land has been recorded in the name of Government as Khas land and classification of land has been shown as Khal (খাল) whereas the plaintiff claimed to have taken settlement of such land from the Government as Naal (খাল) land as it appears from their Kabuliyat and mutated Khatian.
